countries.description: Keep funds whose country or domicile contains any of these names, for example United States, Europe or Germany.
countries.title: Countries or regions

fundCategories.description: Keep only funds in one of these asset classes.
fundCategories.title: Fund categories

fundStatuses.description: Keep only funds in one of these lifecycle states, for example Liquidated or Open.
fundStatuses.title: Fund statuses

fundTypes.description: Keep only funds whose published strategy matches one of these types. Leave empty for all types.
fundTypes.sectionDescription: Filters apply to direct, search and sitemap runs. Leave blank to keep every fund.
fundTypes.title: Fund types

maxFundSize.description: Maximum published fund size in millions of the fund's native currency. Leave empty for no upper bound.
maxFundSize.title: Maximum fund size

maxItems.description: Upper limit on fund records returned. Direct-URL runs process every listed URL; search and sitemap runs stop once this many funds match.
maxItems.title: Maximum funds

maxVintage.description: Maximum vintage year. Leave empty for no upper bound.
maxVintage.title: Latest vintage year

minFundSize.description: Minimum published fund size in millions of the fund's native currency (6.11B becomes 6110). Leave empty for no lower bound.
minFundSize.title: Minimum fund size

minVintage.description: Minimum vintage year. Leave empty for no lower bound.
minVintage.title: Earliest vintage year

profileUrls.description: PitchBook fund profile links or bare IDs (for example https://pitchbook.com/profiles/fund/11295-73F or 11295-73F). When supplied, every listed fund is processed and the other source fields are ignored.
profileUrls.sectionDescription: Choose one source: a list of profiles, a keyword, or the full public sitemap.
profileUrls.title: Fund profile URLs or IDs

searchQuery.description: Fund name, manager or strategy keyword, for example 'Sequoia Capital Fund XV', 'growth equity' or 'buyout europe'. PitchBook's public best match is tried first, then public profiles are scanned for more matches. Used only when no profile URLs are supplied.
searchQuery.title: Keyword search

searchText.description: Keep funds whose name, manager, description, strategy, category or location contains all of these words.
searchText.title: Text filter
